Subject: Request: temporary SLO adjustment for Gen-2 preview deployment

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the fast onboarding call this morning. We’re excited to move our Gen-2 product preview onto Redwood for the next 8 weeks. Two items that came up during our internal risk review:

- The engineering team wants to surface the new Gen-2 family in preview mode; they accept there may be intermittent latency variance during tuning.
- Procurement/legal are asking for clarity on SLOs for the preview period — specifically whether Redwood can sign a short-term carveout for uptime/latency while we validate traffic patterns.

Our ask: a temporary SLO of 99.5% availability (instead of the standard 99.9%) for the first 30 days of the Gen-2 preview for the model profile "gen2-preview-large". We’re prepared to accept additional monitoring instrumentation (detailed logs, alerts) and an agreed rollback trigger if latency exceeds X ms for Y% of requests.

Timing is tight — product plans to flip traffic the week of 7/27. Could your team confirm whether a temporary carveout is feasible and what controls you'd require?

Eve — quick technical note from Product/Runtime:

- 99.5% availability for 30 days is reasonable for a preview if DataCo accepts the following controls:
  1) Prefix and KV-cache instrumentation enabled for the preview model (we need request-level traces).
  2) A rolling rollback policy if p50 latency > 350ms AND p95 > 1.5s for a sustained 10-min window.
  3) Rate-limiting/burst policy enforced until we complete a 72-hour soak at expected qps.

- We should also require DataCo to sign off on a short runbook: who to contact, escalation channels, and whether they want an automatic fallback to a smaller model family.

If Marketing/Sales need softer language in the carveout (e.g., "temporary SLO adjustment for performance tuning"), we can provide that — but the technical annex must include the three controls above.

Karthik
Director, Product — Serving Runtime

Subject: Draft: temporary SLO carveout for DataCo Gen-2 preview (v0.1)

Team — I drafted a short carveout that balances DataCo's ask and our risk controls. Key points below, full text attached: redwood_temp_slo_carveout_v1.pdf

- Scope: gen2-preview-large model profile, Customer: DataCo, preview window: 30 days from 1st production traffic cutover.
- SLO: 99.5% availability for the preview period; standard 99.9% SLA resumes after the preview unless extended by mutual written agreement.
- Observability: full request-level traces, prefix/KV cache metrics, daily roll-up reports to customer via shared Drive link.
- Rollback and safety: automatic throttling if p95 latency > 1.5s for 10 continuous minutes; manual rollback authority assigned to Redwood SRE + DataCo on-call.
- Credits: pro-rated service credit for availability below the carveout threshold; no change to liability limits.

Ask: Evelyn, can you approve sending this to Sarah with the attachments and an optional DocuSign link? Marcus — please confirm commercial language on credits and make sure procurement path is OK. Karthik — confirm the rollback thresholds above are operationally enforceable.

Regards,
Laura
